import statistics as st
vals=[2.04,2.15,2.10,2.45,2.21,1.37,1.68,1.38,3.38,3.48,2.99,3.22,3.44]
diffs=[round(vals[i]-vals[i-1],2) for i in range(1,len(vals))]
print('diffs',diffs)
print('sample sigma',st.stdev(diffs))
print('pop sigma',st.pstdev(diffs))
print('half sample',1.28*st.stdev(diffs))
# If exclude April jump? Last six diff from Mar-Aug = [2.00,.10,-.49,.23,.22] not enough. recent 12 sample std.

    print(yoy, 99.77*(1+yoy/100), 'mom from Aug', 99.77*(1+yoy/100)-103.49)
PY"
